checks.detail: Visible event cards actually animate with staggered start times and settle to readable content.
Pointer tilt responds; a short real drag springs back without a decision POST.
Real mutual match runs the two-card/heart sequence; 390/320 px animation and final states fit.
A confirmed message animates for sender and receiver; the next empty poll neither duplicates nor replays it.
The keyboard opens all six stickers in staggered order, and Escape returns focus to the toggle.
Particles follow confirmed saving, clean up, and do not replay after refresh, unsaving or a denied request.
A successful RSVP draws the check beside the status text, with no replay on refresh or cancellation.
Both reduced-motion settings keep the RSVP check and stickers visible and static, and preserve save, match and chat actions.
No browser exceptions or server 5xx errors during motion inspection.
